basic_info.description:
This fully renovated 2BR/1BA Glen Park home checks all the boxes: modern design, low-maintenance living, and a prime location just 0.3 miles to BART.

Enjoy a brand new kitchen, bath, floors, roof, fireplace, and more. The open layout is complemented by clean finishes and a private turf patio great for pets or outdoor hangs.

A rare 2-car garage with a separate entrance includes laundry, a tankless water heater, and expansion potential (not included in square footage).

A rare turnkey home in a neighborhood loved for its village charm, walkability, and easy access to trails, parks, and cafes.
